document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The legendary mists of the North Hanninah press in. By day, 
you cannot see the sun, and by night the stars are obscured. 
Some magnetic anomaly also affects your compass. Whether it 
is the proximity to the pole or some other reason, you cannot 
say, but your party has gotten itself lost and you have no idea in 
which direction the river lies.
Make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 413; if you fail, go to 132.
